content: docs.github.com events-that-trigger-workflows: workflow_dispatch accepts inputs (string/boolean/choice/environment types with required/default); read via inputs context (github.event.inputs stringifies booleans); triggerable from UI, REST API, or CLI (gh workflow run -f key=value); workflow file must exist on default branch; dispatch ref selectable (GITHUB_REF_NAME = dispatch branch/tag, NOT a release tag) so the tag must come from inputs.tag; release published event sets GITHUB_REF_NAME to the release tag.
